restrictions: Messages are exactly 33 bytes: one independent uniform 256-bit word and one independent uniform byte. Groups of 32 bytes are extracted from fresh independent random words.
One batch of N=511*2^119 independent samples. Repeated messages are retained, charged, and explicitly rejected as collision witnesses. No restart.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256, two prefix rounds, one root compression per message, flags 11, true block length 33, counter 0, zero filling only for word loading.

Partition full digests by their low 128 bits, then detect equal high halves using a direct-address table tagged by the current low half. All tables, initialization, accesses, comparisons, and witness recovery are charged.
Universal fixed-function probability proof. No random-oracle, internal-round, sparse-bucket, or empirical independence heuristic is assumed.
The experiment checks a 16-bit output mask of the exact two-round target and finite detector cases. It supplies implementation evidence, not a full collision or a full-scale cost measurement.
